description: This file defines the TextMessage class within the WPEFramework::Messaging namespace. The class implements a message containing text data, with methods for serialization and deserialization, and manages an internal string _text.

classes.name: TextMessage
classes.description: A class representing a text message that can be serialized and deserialized for messaging purposes within the WPEFramework.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the internal text into a buffer, handling buffer size limitations.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes text data from a buffer into the internal string.

methods.name: Data
methods.description: Returns a const reference to the internal text string.
